image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a physical paper menu. The menu features a beige/cream background with dark text. The text appears to be in an Asian script (likely Chinese or Japanese) but is heavily distorted and illegible, characteristic of AI-generated text artifacts. There are dotted lines separating items, suggesting a price list format. The top section has a darker header area. The focus is soft, and the perspective is tilted.
